text:
maya.g: Customer reports AWS Marketplace invoice doesn't match our usage dashboard for tenant T-98321. They see a large aggregated line item that doesn't map to any of their account IDs :confused:

jamal: which invoice and which marketplace product code?

maya.g: Invoice ID INV-2026-09-01, AWS product code AWS2500-REDWOOD-INFER, invoice line shows quantity 132,000 units. Our usage dashboard for T-98321 shows 48,900 tokens for the same period.

alex_fin: could be tenant attribution or metering records getting grouped under a master reseller account. Do we have the marketplace usage report CSV?

maya.g: attaching exported usage_report.csv from our billing UI (snippet):
```
usage_date,tenant_id,product_code,units
2026-08-01,T-98321,AWS2500-REDWOOD-INFER,48900
2026-08-02,T-98321,AWS2500-REDWOOD-INFER,0
```

lina_sre: I pulled the Marketplace metering logs from our ingestion pipeline for sellerId S-4444, matching product code. Found records with usageResourceId = "acct-9999" and "acct-0001" during the period. Can we confirm which AWS Marketplace account the customer is using?

maya.g: customer says they subscribed via their AWS master account 123456789012 and gave us a SaaS account mapping to tenant T-98321. They insist AWS billed them for more than they used.

jamal: quick repro: call our metering retrieval endpoint for date 2026-08-01: `GET /internal/billing/metering?seller=S-4444&date=2026-08-01` returned 3 records:
```
{"meteringRecordId":"m-111","usageResourceId":"acct-9999","quantity":90000}
{"meteringRecordId":"m-112","usageResourceId":"acct-0001","quantity":42000}
{"meteringRecordId":"m-113","usageResourceId":"acct-1234","quantity":0}
```

jamal: acct-9999 looks like a reseller/partner account that sometimes wraps multiple end-customer subscriptions. That would explain aggregation on the AWS invoice.

alex_fin: if AWS aggregated reseller usage under a single line item, the customer would see the full reseller consumption on their invoice. We need to confirm if the customer's subscription was under a reseller or linked account.

maya.g: Customer insists they subscribed directly. I've asked for their AWS Marketplace subscription ARN and the buyer's account ID. Waiting.

lina_sre: Meanwhile we should prepare an artifact pack for AWS support: meteringRecordIds, timestamps, our sellerId, the mapping of usageResourceId -> tenant in our DB for the period, and their reported invoice line.

jamal: created a ticket draft to AWS Marketplace (support case) with subject: "Unexpected aggregation on invoice line for seller S-4444 - potential reseller attribution". Included meteringRecordIds m-111,m-112,m-113 and sample logs. Case # will be added once submitted.

billing-bot: FYI — raised internal billing alert for tenant T-98321, severity: high, assigned: alex_fin, ticket: BILL-2026-451

maya.g: Customer provided subscription ARN: arn:aws:aws-marketplace:us-east-1::subscription/sub-777. Buyer account: 123456789012. They also attached the AWS invoice PDF page showing the single line with quantity 132,000.

alex_fin: cross-checking our mapping: usageResourceId acct-9999 maps to customer master account 123456789012 in older imports (we recently normalized). There might be a time-window where we failed to attach sub-account consumption to tenant T-98321 and instead attributed to acct-9999.

lina_sre: found a bug in the nightly importer: if marketplace token "buyerAccountId" equals masterId, we fall back to usageResourceId without checking subscription ARN. Patch ready, will deploy to staging now.

jamal: good. Steps: 1) deploy fix to staging and re-run importer for 2026-08-01..08-07, 2) generate a reconciliation report mapping meteringRecordId -> tenant, 3) share with AWS support and customer, 4) if AWS confirms invoice grouping, advise customer on refund path or credit.

maya.g: I'm on it. Customer asked for ETA — can we aim to have an initial reconciliation within 24 hours?

lina_sre: yes, staging deploy + reimport should finish in ~6 hours, then recon report generation another 2.

aws-mkt-support: Hi team, received case related to aggregation. Please attach the following: sellerId, sample meteringRecordId values, subscription ARN, invoice pdf. We can check whether the billing was consolidated under a reseller or master payer.

alex_fin: attaching artifact bundle to AWS case now. Also flagging for finance to prepare potential credit if reconciliation shows misattribution.

maya.g: customer updated: they see the same aggregated charge on GCP too for a different project — linking that ticket separately. For this thread AWS only.

jamal: noted. Closing loop here after reimport. Will post final reconciliation CSV in this thread. :thumbsup:
